title: Transfer: Estuary Salinity Intrusion Attribution
goal: Investigate an estuary dataset to identify the dominant Heat, Flow, Wind, or Human category behind worsening dry-season salinity intrusion and report that category’s contribution percentage.
skillBenefitRationale: This moves the skill into a coastal setting, but success still depends on correctly grouping river, atmospheric, wind, and development variables into the prescribed driver classes before ranking category contributions.
